name: bridge-ai-desktop
description: Bridge AI as a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux
author: Bridge AI contributors

scripts.dist: node stage.js && npm run icons && electron-builder

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Bridge AI records voice notes and meetings you start. Audio is transcribed with the engine you pick in Settings.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Bridge AI records a call's sound for the meeting notes you start, so the transcript has both sides.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Bridge AI shows your schedule in Today and names meeting notes after their event. Your events stay on this Mac.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Bridge AI shows your schedule in Today and names meeting notes after their event. Your events stay on this Mac.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Bridge AI shows your projects, lets your agents work in the folders you pick, and suggests files you saved for a meeting.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Bridge AI shows your projects, lets your agents work in the folders you pick, and saves meeting notes where you choose.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Bridge AI lets your agents work in the folders you pick, and suggests files you downloaded for a meeting, like a resume or a deck.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Bridge AI asks Finder to move a file you discard to the Trash.

linux.synopsis: Run and talk to all your AI coding agents
